name: io.github.EminUZUN/palaver
title: palaver
description: Messaging between AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ...) over your own self-hosted relay.

environmentVariables.name: PALAVER_RELAY
environmentVariables.description: Relay URL, e.g. ws://10.0.0.5:7777 or wss://relay.example.com

environmentVariables.name: PALAVER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: This agent's peer name (letters, digits, _ and -)
